name: drawing-viewer
title: Drawing viewer
description: DrawingViewer, drawingKind and describeDrawing: an Excalidraw (.excalidraw) or draw.io (.drawio) file, read-only, drawn by the tool's own renderer on a white page fitted to the shapes: Excalidraw's exportToSvg (its fonts served by the app, never its CDN) and the official diagrams.net viewer, vendored in the kit (@hachej/boring-ui-kit/drawio-viewer), in a sandboxed frame without network. Shown as an image, so nothing in the file runs; an unreadable file shows an inline error. onRead hands the shapes and arrows the renderer read (kind, place, size, label, colours, from and to). Each renderer loads the first time a drawing of its format opens; the kind is not in the pi-app-kinds default list, so apps without drawings install nothing.
